Scope: road works, storm, sewer, potable water and TSE networks, electrical works, fence and gates, a bridge and landscaping. Contract value 86.8M SAR, 24 months.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours. At 75.2% against a plan of 49.1%, the project is 26.1% ahead (SPI 1.53). This week it gained 1.77% against 1.10% planned, more than twice last week's 0.77%. Yet the schedule now forecasts completion 198 days after the contract date, another week later than last week.

Well ahead on progress, but the forecast finish is six months late. Both the weekly report and the P6 update forecast completion on 03-Jun-2028, 198 days after the contract completion date of 18-Nov-2027, with −169 days of total float (−163 last week). Every open milestone slipped another 7 days this week, the third weekly slip in a row. Roads and medium voltage, the WBS that is behind plan (73.5% against 100%, unchanged for three weeks), depends on the MV network, which is waiting for the MODON–SEC agreement; MV cable, ring main units and lighting substations have not been ordered.

Data notes

Built from the 03-Nov-2026 weekly upload (W06), with the 27-Oct-2026 upload (W05) for this week's changes.

  • Week number: the report states week 49.86 (whole weeks since site handover: 49); the file reference is WPR-050.
  • Physical progress differs between sheets: the dashboard shows 75.2% (537,033 of 714,561 man-hours), while the P6 export and the Physical-Chart Data sheet show 76.6% (547,132 man-hours).
  • The weekly summary file (works executed this week) and the Look Ahead and Conclusion sheets label cost-based progress as "actual"; this report uses physical % complete (man-hours) only. The weekly summary file also gives project code JDH3-03-011, contract value 86,742,345 and an expected finish of 30-Nov-2026, as does the Look Ahead sheet; the dashboard and P6 forecast 03-Jun-2028.
  • MODON PM: Eng. Abdallah Aljulayfi in the General Information sheet; م. رضا المنشاوي in the Look Ahead sheet and the weekly summary file.
  • Milestones: P6 and the weekly report still swap the roads/MV and deep-network forecast dates, and the dashboard's "Original (Baseline)" column shows latest-plan dates.
  • Manpower: the summary panel is now labelled November but still shows October's figures (148 planned, 182 actual), while the November plan is 187. HSE reports 3,072 man-hours for the week, a third of the 9,216 reported in each of the two previous weeks.
  • Material Monitoring: the revised quantity of lighting poles and luminaires changed from 404 to 443 (all delivered), and the installed quantity of the 6,115 m low-voltage cable line went from 230 m back to 6,115 m.
  • The Procurement Log content is unchanged for the third week running.
  • Invoice 8 carries a 36,000 deduction, also shown as penalties on the dashboard; the reason is not stated.
  • HDPE pipes: the Major Quantities sheet does not name the network; potable water and TSE are inferred from quantities, and installed quantities differ from the Material Monitoring sheet.
  • Equipment cumulative actual stays at 564 from July although monthly counts continue. Several dashboard cells show #REF! errors.
